Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Monroe for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 4 of them free. New in this update: Light Up Monroe Tree Lighting at Travelers Park (November 29), Holiday Spark at the Evergreen State Fair Park (from December 3) and Old Country Christmas at Legacy Farm (from December 5). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.
